_comment: Strasbourg prenylation batch, Linux CPU-only server. Derived from the validated
config.strasbourg-fast.json with every Windows path replaced.
IMPORTANT: sidecar_python paths must be ABSOLUTE and start with '/'. A Windows-style
'c:/...' path is RELATIVE on Linux, and script resolution then builds nonsense paths
before failing with a message naming a Windows directory.
Run `mumdia doctor --config config.strasbourg-linux.json` BEFORE the batch: the rescore
runs after all 83 per-run chains, so a wrong interpreter would otherwise be discovered
at the very end. (preflight now also checks the interpreters exist.)
